description: This file defines the EmployeeImmigrationController class in the OrangeHRM system. It manages the pre-render logic for the employee immigration view, including setting up a Vue component with employee-specific immigration data and permissions, and checks for valid employee number.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing employee immigration information view, extending BaseViewEmployeeController and utilizing ServiceContainerTrait for dependency management.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and Vue component for rendering the employee immigration page, setting employee number, country list, and permissions if valid employee number is provided.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array of data groups required for capability permission checks, here specifically for 'immigration'.
